lessons_used: Bypassing onboarding steps directly (new_flow) significantly improves conversion.
Reordering friction by moving sign-in after pet selection (reorder) significantly improves conversion.
Major redesigns (redesign) and sign-in hints (hint) significantly hurt performance.
Copy updates, permission checks, layout changes, and notifications showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated actual measured gains across tests.

candidates.title: Express pet preset flow bypass
candidates.change: Provide preset pet choices directly on the pet pick screen to skip mandatory photo uploads.
candidates.why: Adoption has low conversion (69.3%) and a mean completion time of 1017s due to photo upload friction.

pick_friend.headline: Pick a Starter Pet
pick_friend.body: Select a ready-made companion or customize one later.

guard.reason: Valid onboarding update allowing pet selection without breaking required flow steps.

candidates.score_note: Bypassing photo upload friction with a new flow aligns with high-performing historical interventions.

candidates.title: Move waiting screen after sign-in
candidates.change: Reorder the waiting screen to appear after sign-in so generation happens in the background while reviewing home intro.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median delay (201s) and mean delay (2336s), delaying onboarding completion.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Pet control tutorial screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated tutorial screen before finishing onboarding explaining desktop controls and hiding features.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or interact with pets after setup.

new_pet_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_guide.body: Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet directly from your desktop system tray.

guard.reason: Adding new tutorial screens after home_intro is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a mandatory tutorial screen introduces extra friction and risks dropping conversion.

candidates.title: Pick friend grid layout overhaul
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a grid layout for quick visual comparisons.
candidates.why: Adoption takes a long median time of 89s, showing friction in exploring available options.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select your favorite pet to get started.

guard.reason: Redesigning the companion selection layout maintains the original screen's function.

candidates.score_note: Major redesigns historically hurt performance significantly.

candidates.title: Clear photo upload tips
candidates.change: Add clear photo criteria copy to reduce custom pet generation errors.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use clear, front-facing photos in good lighting for the best 3D pet quality.

guard.reason: Adding photo quality guidance updates onboarding copy without breaking any rules.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support emails and cheap to implement, though copy updates yield minimal lift.

candidates.title: Estimated generation time countdown
candidates.change: Display an estimated time remaining indicator on the pet generation wait screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step drops conversion to 81.3% with an extreme mean wait time of 2336s.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet
waiting.body: Your custom pet is rendering. This takes about 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Time estimates for real waiting processes are explicitly allowed under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Wait time info updates showed negligible measured gain in past tests.

candidates.title: Desktop notification when pet is ready
candidates.change: Trigger a desktop system notification when pet generation completes so users can switch back.
candidates.why: Mean wait time of 2336s indicates users leave the desktop app unattended while waiting.

guard.reason: Adding a completion notification on the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Notification changes previously yielded slight negative lift.

candidates.title: Starter item bundle reward
candidates.change: Show a welcome reward announcement highlighting free pet accessories on the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish step drops off significantly to 64.8% completion rate.

home_intro.headline: Welcome! Starter Items Unlocked
home_intro.body: Your pet arrived with a free care pack of treats and toys in your tray menu.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'free' extras ('free care pack'), violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Compact adoption certificate layout
candidates.change: Change adoption certificate presentation to a compact card format.
candidates.why: Simplifying the certificate review stage reduces adoption step drop-off (69.3% conversion).

guard.reason: Changing the layout format of the adoption certificate is permitted under Rule 2.

candidates.score_note: Layout adjustments showed no clear effect in prior iterations.

candidates.title: Sign-in data protection text
candidates.change: Clarify on the sign-in screen that creating an account saves pet profiles and prevents loss.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet Progress
sign_in.body: Sign in to protect your pet profile and restore it anytime on this computer.

guard.reason: Clarifying sign-in benefits without requesting new personal data is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High support email evidence and config-only cost, but copy changes have modest overall impact.

lessons_next: Reordering friction (moving sign-in after pet selection), adding a pet control tutorial screen, and estimated countdown wait info won.
Bypassing onboarding steps (new_flow) yielded mixed results, winning in one test but significantly hurting in another.
Major redesigns and sign-in safety hints significantly hurt performance.
Copy updates, permission checks, layout changes, and notifications showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated actual gains, but underestimated performance for the tutorial screen and countdown info.
